$comment: Monsters the ring of recoil (and the ring of suffering's recoil) does not damage: OSRS Wiki, Category:Monsters immune to recoil. Matched by NPC name. Left out because the name is shared with monsters that are not immune: Skeleton Hellhound and Greater Skeleton Hellhound (only Vet'ion's and Calvar'ion's), Evil Chicken, Ogre shaman, Bee Swarm, Husk, Parasite, Undead tree. Hespori sets its own immunity attribute. `ids` are immune by NPC id where the name is shared: the Judge of Yama in A Kingdom Divided (akd_judge_of_yama_combat, 10938) only, not the Yama fight's (yama_judge_of_yama, 14180), which the Wiki category leaves out.
